text:
mira: Quick check-in 10m. Need final hero+subhead options for Hosted / Dedicated / Private so we can lock 3 landing variants for the launch page and the webinar page.

sam: OK. I'm pushing two hosted variants: one benefits-led, one technical.

olivia: Drop them in the doc and I'll pick microcopy that fits the grid.

mira: Link to doc: https://docs.google.com/launch-landing-variants (commented).

sam: Hosted A (benefit): 'Hosted API: Launch LLM features in minutes' / subhead: 'Production-ready endpoints with predictable latency and usage analytics.'

sam: Hosted B (technical): 'Hosted API: High-throughput inference, zero ops' / subhead: 'Smart batching, prefix caching, and latency SLAs for production apps.'

noah: For Dedicated, two takes: throughput-first and compliance-first.

noah: Dedicated A: 'Reserved GPU pools for consistent throughput' / subhead: 'Scale with predictable capacity, autoscale controls, and SLAs.'

noah: Dedicated B: 'Dedicated capacity for mission-critical apps' / subhead: 'Isolation, performance guarantees, and flexible scaling.'

lia: Private needs to emphasize networking and keys.

lia: Private A: 'Private deployment: control where inference runs' / subhead: 'VPC, on-prem, and KMS integrations for regulated workloads.'

lia: Private B: 'Air-gapped and VPC deployments for sensitive data' / subhead: 'Enterprise controls, audit logs, and role-based access.'

olivia: These are solid. Suggest microcopy edits: swap 'SLA' -> 'SLA-backed uptime available' for legal safety.

mira: Agree. Also prefer shorter hero sentences for mobile.

emma: CTA options we should A/B: 'See benchmarks' / 'Reserve your seat' / 'Get migration guide'. My vote for top-of-funnel is 'See benchmarks'.

sam: For acquisition channels use 'See benchmarks', webinar landing use 'Reserve your seat', enterprise email use 'Get migration guide'.

noah: Webinar blurb draft: 'Operational inference that scales 1: benchmarks, tradeoffs, migration patterns.' Bullets: - Live Hosted API latency demo; - How Dedicated autoscale keeps tails down; - Private deployment network checklist + KMS demo.

lia: Add a 15-min enterprise office hour after the webinar. Tag registrants via `enterprise_interest`.

marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar time is 2026-04-07T16:00Z. Please confirm presenters.
